title: T10 — Closure review
body:
# T10 — Closure review

Project: T10 — SAFe cadence and MSP tranches · Track: v2 · Tranche: 4 · Plan: docs/SPEC_V2.md §12
Measured at: main@f14b7d36, 2026-11-19 · Project row: closed

## Outcome vs acceptance

The acceptance set is the `docs/SPEC_V2.md` §12 row T10, whose gate has five clauses. The project brief restates the first three verbatim as its acceptance; the SPEC row governs this review.

| Acceptance clause | Evidence | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| PI planning materialises cards from the backlog by WSJF within WIP | `crates/store/src/spine.rs:materialise_pi_tx` (slots = active lane `wip_limit` − live cards); `crates/store/tests/programme_cadence.rs::wsjf_is_computed_not_stored` (order `high, mid, low`; no `wsjf` column), `::materialisation_respects_wip_slots`, `::a_zero_job_size_is_refused`; `apps/server/tests/cadence_jobs.rs::pi_tick_is_idempotent` | pass — the entry point is the worker tick (`apps/server/src/cadence.rs:tick`), not an action |
| A deliverable without evidence cannot demo | `crates/store/src/spine.rs:credit_demo_tx` refuses a non-`accepted` deliverable and an empty evidence array; `crates/store/tests/demo_gate.rs::evidence_less_deliverable_cannot_demo` | pass — delivered as `programme_demo_credit`, not the approval primitive the design chose |
| Retro produces lessons | `crates/store/src/spine.rs:open_retro_tx`, `:record_retro_findings_tx`, `:close_retro_tx` (refuses a finding with no lesson); `crates/store/tests/retro.rs::every_finding_becomes_a_lesson`, `::retro_cannot_close_without_lessons` | pass — T10 built its own `lesson` table, contrary to its design |
| An end-of-tranche review with no baselines, benefit status or risk evidence is refused | `crates/store/src/spine.rs:review_tranche_tx`; `crates/domain/src/spine.rs:tranche_review_has_evidence`; `crates/store/tests/tranche_review.rs::a_review_without_evidence_is_refused`, `::a_rebaseline_goes_through_change_control`, `::a_project_cannot_start_before_its_tranche_is_authorised` | pass |
| A transition that never measured its baseline cannot report the benefit realized | `crates/store/src/spine.rs:benefit_realization_tx` returns `BenefitBaselineMissing`; `crates/store/tests/benefit_transition.rs::a_missing_baseline_cannot_claim_realization` | partial — proven on the transition path, but `benefits.update(status='realized')` bypasses it |

Four clauses pass and one is partial. The brief's three-clause acceptance is contained in rows 1–3, all pass. The partial is real: `crates/actions/src/spine/mod.rs:benefits_update` permits `realized` in its status list and writes it through `BenefitPatch`, and no `realized` guard exists in `crates/store/src/spine.rs`, so a benefit profile can be marked realized with no measured transition — the exact bypass the project's inception analysis listed as risk 4.

## Evidence

- Merge: PR #368 at `e452523f8ce9f339022502984ccb4354fb506aed`, 2026-11-18; issue #82 CLOSED 2026-11-18T21:40:52Z. All paths below resolve at main@`f14b7d36`.
- `migrations/0056_cadence_tranche.sql` — `lesson`, `programme_demo_credit` (unique per cadence and deliverable, evidence copied onto the credit), and `programme_tranche.authorised_at` / `authorisation_review_id`.
- Store: `crates/store/src/spine.rs` — `materialise_pi_tx`, `credit_demo_tx`, `propose_lesson_tx`, `open_retro_tx`, `record_retro_findings_tx`, `close_retro_tx`, `review_tranche_tx`, `project_tranche_state_tx`, `assert_project_tranche_authorised_tx`, `benefit_realization_tx`, `close_programme_tx`.
- Wiring: `crates/actions/src/programme.rs:assert_project_can_start` calls the tranche-authorisation read before the dependency and inception gates (refusal `409 tranche_not_authorised`); `apps/server/src/cadence.rs:tick` is invoked from `apps/server/src/worker.rs:286`.
- Tests: five store binaries — `crates/store/tests/programme_cadence.rs`, `demo_gate.rs`, `retro.rs`, `tranche_review.rs`, `benefit_transition.rs` — plus `apps/server/tests/cadence_jobs.rs`.
- CI at the merge sha: push `ci` run 44403960831, conclusion success (21m34s); CodeQL 44403957783, `board` 44403960776 and `delivery` 44403960627 success. The `issue-registry` run 44403960626 failed; it is a registry-refresh workflow, not the gate.
- This review did not run the tests locally; the pass verdicts rest on the merged test source and that CI record.

## Open items

1. **Realized-status bypass** — add a guard at `benefits.update` or route `realized` through the transition; until then clause 5 is policy only on one path. No code or action for it exists at this baseline.
2. **Cadence execution actions absent** — `cadences.plan|demo|retro|refine` and `benefits.strategy|realization_plan|report` are not in the action registry; execution is the tick. Decide whether the design is amended to the tick or the actions are built.
3. **Refinement unbuilt** — no stale-item read exists, so D-T10-6 has no implementation.
4. **`wbs_node.planned_cadence_id` unbuilt** — no row records which cadence planned an item; a later PI period re-selects unplanned backlog.
5. **Lesson ownership** — T10 built the `lesson` table its analysis assigned to T8; reconcile with T8/T5 before a second lesson store appears.
6. **Demo gate shape** — `programme_demo_credit` replaces the designed `approval` row; either is a gate, but only one is the architecture of record.
7. **`crates/actions/tests/cadence_t10.rs`** — named by the design, absent at baseline.

Ownership of items 1–7 is not established by anything in the merged tree; none carries an issue, branch or PR that this review observed. They are recorded as open, not as satisfied.

## Decision

T10 is CLOSED. The close is the owner's act, already recorded: issue #82 closed 2026-11-18T21:40:52Z and PR #368 merged 2026-11-18T21:40:50Z at `e452523f`. This review neither repeats nor re-grants that approval; it records the per-clause verdicts and the evidence behind them. The close stands on four passing clauses and one partial: the cadence, demo, retro and tranche rules are implemented and tested, while realized-status remains reachable without a measured transition. The seven open items above are carried forward as open, so a later reader cannot mistake this closure for a claim that the design was delivered whole.
